title: Payday and Payroll Schedule
content:
Payroll Schedule at NovaTech Solutions:

Payday:
- Salary is credited on the last working day of every month
- If the last day is a weekend or holiday, salary is credited the preceding Friday
- Example: If October 31 is a Sunday, salary is credited on October 29 (Friday)

Payroll Cut-off Dates:
- Attendance and leave records are finalized by the 28th of each month
- Expense reimbursements submitted by 25th are included in the same month's payroll
- Late submissions go into the next month's payroll

Salary Slip:
- Available on HR Portal > 'Payroll' > 'My Salary Slips' by the 1st of the following month
- Password for salary slip PDF: First 4 letters of your name in uppercase + your year of birth
  Example: JOHN1990

Salary Credit:
- Via NEFT to your registered bank account
- If salary is delayed (technical issues), HR will send a communication by 5 PM on payday
- For bank-related issues: payroll@novatech.com or ext. 3010

Bonus Payout:
- Annual Performance Bonus: Announced with annual appraisal results (February), paid in March
- Joining/Sign-on Bonus (if applicable): 50% on joining, 50% after 6 months
- Referral Bonus: 50% on candidate joining, 50% after 6 months of their tenure

Payroll Corrections:
- Report discrepancies within 7 days of receiving salary slip
- Correction processed in the next month's payroll

title: Tax Declaration and Investment Proof Submission
content:
Tax Declaration Process at NovaTech Solutions:

Tax Regime:
- Employees must declare their tax regime preference (Old Regime or New Regime) at the start of the financial year (April)
- HR Portal > 'Payroll' > 'Tax Regime Selection'
- Default if no selection made: New Tax Regime (lower rates, fewer exemptions)

Old Tax Regime Benefits:
- HRA exemption (if you pay rent)
- Standard deduction: INR 50,000
- 80C deductions: PF, ELSS, LIC, PPF, home loan principal (up to INR 1.5L)
- 80D: Health insurance premium (up to INR 25,000)
- LTA (Leave Travel Allowance): 2 journeys in a 4-year block

New Tax Regime Benefits:
- Lower slab rates (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%)
- Standard deduction: INR 75,000 (FY 2024–25 onwards)
- No other exemptions applicable

Investment Declaration (April–March):
1. HR Portal > 'Payroll' > 'Investment Declaration'
2. Declare planned investments for the year to reduce TDS (tax deducted at source)
3. Final declaration with actual proof: January–February

Investment Proof Submission:
- Submit receipts for ELSS, LIC premiums, PPF passbook, home loan statement, rent receipts
- HR Portal > 'Payroll' > 'Submit Investment Proofs'
- Deadline: February 15 (earlier is better to avoid bulk TDS in March)

Form 16:
- Issued by HR/Payroll by June 15 every year (for the previous financial year)
- Available on HR Portal > 'Payroll' > 'Form 16'
- Use Form 16 to file your personal income tax return by July 31

title: Salary Structure and CTC Breakdown
content:
Salary Structure at NovaTech Solutions:

CTC Components:
1. Basic Salary (40–50% of CTC)
   - Base for PF, gratuity, and leave encashment calculation

2. House Rent Allowance (HRA) (40% of Basic for Bengaluru)
   - Exempt from tax if you pay rent (submit rent receipts)

3. Special Allowance
   - Fully taxable; flexible component

4. Medical Allowance
   - INR 15,000/year (exempt up to INR 15,000 with bills)

5. Leave Travel Allowance (LTA)
   - INR 20,000/year; claimable for domestic travel (2 times in 4-year block)

6. Meal Vouchers/Coupons
   - INR 26,400/year (INR 2,200/month); tax-exempt for food

7. Employer PF Contribution
   - 12% of Basic (employer contribution; employee also contributes 12% Basic)

8. Gratuity (Employer Provision)
   - 4.81% of Basic; vests after 5 years of continuous service

9. Performance Bonus
   - Variable; target bonus percentage in offer letter (e.g., 15% of CTC for L4)

10. Flex Benefits
    - Customizable per employee declaration (fuel, books, internet reimbursement)

Net Salary = Gross Salary – TDS – Employee PF (12% Basic) – ESI (if applicable) – Meal deductions

Salary Revision:
- Annual revision: Effective April 1 (post-appraisal)
- Off-cycle revision: Rare, for exceptional performers or role changes
- Salary bands per level are published internally on the HR Portal (Policies section)

Payslip Explanation:
- HR Portal > 'Payroll' > 'Payslip Help' has a detailed payslip decoder

title: ESOP / Stock Options Vesting Policy
content:
Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) at NovaTech Solutions:

Eligibility:
- All full-time employees at L4 (Senior Engineer / Senior Analyst) and above receive ESOP grants
- L1–L3 employees may receive spot grants for exceptional performance
- ESOPs are granted annually in February, aligned with appraisal results

Vesting Schedule:
- Standard cliff: 1 year (25% of grant vests after 1 year)
- Monthly vesting thereafter: Remaining 75% vests over 36 months (2.083%/month)
- Total vesting period: 4 years

Example:
- Grant: 1,000 options on February 1, 2023
- February 1, 2024: 250 options vest (1-year cliff)
- March 1, 2024 onwards: 20.83 options vest per month (~21)
- February 1, 2027: All 1,000 options fully vested

Exercise:
- Options can be exercised at the strike price stated in your grant letter
- Exercise window: 90 days after leaving the company
- Tax: ESOP exercise is taxable as perquisite (TDS at time of exercise)

Grant Letter:
- Sent via email from ESOP administrator (equity@novatech.com)
- Accept on the equity portal (link in the email)
- View all grants and vesting schedule: https://equity.novatech.internal

Leaving the Company:
- Vested options: Exercise within 90 days of leaving (or forfeit)
- Unvested options: Forfeited immediately on separation
- Accelerated vesting: In case of company acquisition/IPO (as per grant letter terms)

For questions: Contact equity@novatech.com or HR Payroll (payroll@novatech.com)

title: Provident Fund (PF) and Gratuity
content:
Provident Fund (PF) and Gratuity at NovaTech Solutions:

Provident Fund (EPF):
- Mandatory for employees with basic salary up to INR 15,000/month
- Voluntary for those above this threshold
- Employee Contribution: 12% of Basic Salary per month
- Employer Contribution: 12% of Basic Salary (3.67% to EPF, 8.33% to EPS)

UAN (Universal Account Number):
- Your PF account is linked to your UAN
- View your UAN on HR Portal > 'Payroll' > 'PF Details'
- Activate UAN at https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in
- Link your Aadhaar and bank account to UAN for easy withdrawal

PF Balance Check:
- SMS 'EPFOHO UAN ENG' to 7738299899 (registered mobile)
- Or check on EPFO Umang app / unified portal

PF Transfer (Previous Employer):
- Login to EPFO portal > Online Services > Transfer Request
- Requires your previous employer's establishment code
- Or contact payroll@novatech.com for assistance

Gratuity:
- Eligibility: 5 years of continuous service
- Formula: (Last Basic Salary × 15 × Number of Years) / 26
- Example: Basic INR 50,000, 6 years → (50,000 × 15 × 6) / 26 = INR 1,73,077
- Tax Exempt up to INR 20 lakhs (FY 2024–25)
- Paid within 30 days of separation (if eligible)

Voluntary PF:
- Contribute more than 12% voluntarily (up to 100% of basic)
- Higher VPF reduces taxable income under 80C (combined limit INR 1.5L)
- Apply via HR Portal > 'Payroll' > 'Voluntary PF'

title: Salary Increment and Revision Process
content:
Salary Increment Policy at NovaTech Solutions:

Annual Increment Cycle:
- Increments are effective April 1 every year
- Announced in February (with appraisal results)
- Disbursed in April payroll (with March–April arrears if applicable)

Increment Bands (indicative, based on performance rating):
- Rating 5 (Exceptional): 15–25% increment
- Rating 4 (Exceeds Expectations): 10–15%
- Rating 3 (Meets Expectations): 5–10%
- Rating 2 (Needs Improvement): 0–3%
- Rating 1 (Below Expectations): 0% (and PIP initiated)

Promotion Increment:
- In addition to regular increment, promotion carries a 15–30% additional increment (role-based)

Salary Revision Letter:
- Sent via email from HR in February
- View on HR Portal > 'My Employment' > 'Increment Letter'
- Letter is password protected (same as salary slip password)

Off-Cycle Salary Revision:
- Rare; may occur for: Counter-offers, role changes, market adjustment
- Requires VP-level + HR Head approval
- Count-offer policy: NovaTech may match up to 80% of a counter-offer for key talent

Tracker for Compensation Growth:
- HR Portal > 'My Employment' > 'Compensation History' shows all revisions since joining

Questions About Your Increment:
- Speak to your manager first
- Escalate to your HR Business Partner if unresolved
- HR BP contact: See 'Key HR Contacts' document
